DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic/Starvation Jaundice)

The direct bilirubin is normal at 0.6 mg/dL, ruling out biliary obstruction. Since your baby is exclusively breastfeeding and the jaundice likely started after the first 24 hours, this is most consistent with dehydration or insufficient milk intake rather than pathologic jaundice or biliary atresia. Please ensure frequent feeding or supplementation to help resolve the bilirubin levels.
